'''Time-drifting''' was an extension of the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] ability of [[flow-walking]], where an individual moved along the threads of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to travel backward or forward in [[Time/Legends|time]]. [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] learnt this technique and revisited the final days of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to find out information about his fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]]. This ability still had its risks; if time-drifters were seen by those they visited, it could create shifts in the flow of time by altering the visited individual's actions.
